identityDecisions.decision: Split NPC 878 into skogre-zombie; keep NPCs 872 and 879 in skogre.
identityDecisions.reason: The raw versioned infobox assigns 878 to Ogres/Zombies and 872/879 to Ogres/Skeletons; category unions would incorrectly allow kills.

identityDecisions.decision: Keep existing task-specific boss IDs as the canonical task joins.
identityDecisions.reason: King Black Dragon, Dagannoth Kings, Alchemical Hydra, Sire, Kree'arra, K'ril, Cerberus, Vorkath, Thermonuclear smoke devil and Kalphite Queen already have task or phase representations. Do not add duplicate boss-prefixed IDs.

identityDecisions.decision: Mark reanimated elf/dagannoth/bloodveld/troll, Dreadborn Araxyte and four skeleton hellhound summons advisorRepeatable=false.
identityDecisions.reason: Keep task-counting context visible without recommending independently farmable encounters; reanimation is anchored at the Dark Altar with local-drop alternatives in task notes.

identityDecisions.decision: Do not link the-jormungand as a repeatable Basilisks recommendation.
identityDecisions.reason: The current source identifies a one-off quest form. Quest-specific catalogue and preparation support remains outside this link correction.

identityDecisions.decision: Do not link Tarn's Lair Skeleton Hellhound to Skeletons.
